C0186.title: Yangzhou Company Convicted for Paid Deletion of Negative Reviews, Illegal Business Operations
keywords: Yangzhou Economic and Technological Development Zone People's Procuratorate
C0186.summary: In November 2024, the People's Procuratorate of Yangzhou Economic and Technological Development Zone prosecuted an e-commerce company and its legal representative, Deng, for illegal business operations.
